title: crossingSampleLower: the sampled-point form of the slack lower bound
statement: The sampled-point restatement of crossingLower: (a + crossingIndex*eps) - 3*eps/2 <= b, the matching slack lower bound derived from crossingLower by the same sampled-point rewrite.
